section.content: 本实用新型公开一种锂离子电池，包括壳体、设置在壳体内的卷绕式电芯和设置在壳体外的消磁件，卷绕式电芯包括正极片和负极片，卷绕成型后的卷绕式电芯的负极片具有超出正极片长度方向的端部的延长部，消磁件包括主体和辅助消磁体，主体呈弧形，主体的曲率与卷绕式电芯的卷绕曲率大致相同，主体的一端与壳体电导通，主体的另一端与辅助消磁体连接，辅助消磁体设置在壳体的侧部并与延长部的位置对应。本实用新型的锂离子电池的消磁件主体在通电时产生的电流方向与负极片的电流方向相反，以使产生的磁场方向与延长部的磁场相反，能够抵消大部分延长部产生的磁场，而且辅助消磁体通电也能够产生磁场，进一步抵消部分主体未能抵消的磁场。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a shell, a winding type battery cell arranged in the shell and a demagnetizing piece arranged outside the shell, wherein the winding type battery cell comprises a positive plate and a negative plate, the negative plate of the winding type battery cell after winding forming is provided with an extending part which exceeds the end part of the positive plate in the length direction, the demagnetizing piece comprises a main body and an auxiliary demagnetizing body, the main body is arc-shaped, the curvature of the main body is approximately the same as the winding curvature of the winding type battery cell, one end of the main body is electrically communicated with the shell, the other end of the main body is connected with the auxiliary demagnetizing body, and the auxiliary demagnetizing body is arranged on the side part of the shell and corresponds to the position of the extending part. The demagnetizing element body of the lithium ion battery provided by the utility model generates a current in a direction opposite to that of the negative pole piece when being electrified, so that the generated magnetic field is in a direction opposite to that of the magnetic field of the extension part, most of the magnetic field generated by the extension part can be offset, and the auxiliary demagnetizing body can generate a magnetic field when being electrified, and further offset the magnetic field which can not be offset by part of the body.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

With the popularity and popularity of electronic devices such as wireless bluetooth headsets, button-type lithium ion batteries are widely used in electronic devices.

The core inside the current button-type lithium ion battery is generally a winding-type core, the winding-type core is usually formed by winding a positive plate, a diaphragm and a negative plate after being stacked, but because the length of the negative plate of the winding-type core is larger than that of the positive plate, a magnetic field generated by the part of the negative plate which is long out can interfere with surrounding electromagnetic sensitive devices (such as a loudspeaker), thereby reducing the quality of electronic equipment and the use experience of users.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The embodiment of the utility model aims to: provided is a lithium ion battery which has a simple structure and can cancel out a magnetic field generated by an extension of a negative electrode sheet of a wound cell.

To achieve the purpose, the embodiment of the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a shell, a winding type battery cell arranged in the shell and a demagnetizing piece arranged outside the shell, wherein the winding type battery cell comprises a positive plate and a negative plate, the negative plate of the winding type battery cell after winding forming is provided with an extending part which exceeds the end part of the positive plate in the length direction, the demagnetizing piece comprises a main body and an auxiliary demagnetizing body, the main body is arc-shaped, the curvature of the main body is approximately the same as the winding curvature of the winding type battery cell, one end of the main body is electrically communicated with the shell, the other end of the main body is connected with the auxiliary demagnetizing body, and the auxiliary demagnetizing body is arranged on the side part of the shell and corresponds to the extending part.

In a preferred embodiment of the lithium ion battery, a length of the main body is greater than or equal to a length of the extension portion.

As a preferred technical solution of the lithium ion battery, the demagnetizing piece is welded on the casing, and the lithium ion battery further includes an insulating layer that isolates the casing from the demagnetizing piece except for the welding position.

As a preferable technical solution of the lithium ion battery, the insulating layer wraps the parts of the degaussing member except for the welding position; or the like, or, alternatively,

the insulating layer is disposed between the housing and the demagnetizing member.

As a preferred technical solution of the lithium ion battery, the main body is disposed at the top or the bottom of the casing, the arc radius of the main body 31 is a, the radius of the top or the bottom of the casing is r, and a is not greater than r.

As a preferred technical scheme of the lithium ion battery, an insulating layer is arranged between the shell and the part of the demagnetization component except for the welding position, the insulating layer is made of insulating gummed paper, a gummed paper opening is formed in the insulating gummed paper, and the main body penetrates through the gummed paper opening and is fixedly connected to the end face of the shell.

As a preferred technical solution of the lithium ion battery, the shape of the adhesive tape is a sector, the vertex of the opening of the adhesive tape is the center of the adhesive tape, and the central angle of the opening of the adhesive tape is within the threshold range of the included angle.

As a preferable technical scheme of the lithium ion battery, the included angle threshold range is 30-120 degrees.

As a preferred technical solution of the lithium ion battery, the main body is disposed at a side portion of the housing, a height of the main body 31 is b, a height of the housing is h, and b is less than or equal to h.

As a preferable technical solution of the lithium ion battery, an insulating sleeve is sleeved on a side portion of the housing.

As a preferred technical solution of the lithium ion battery, a part of the main body is disposed on the top of the housing, and another part is disposed on the side of the housing; or the like, or, alternatively,

one part of the main body is arranged at the bottom of the shell, and the other part of the main body is arranged at the side of the shell.

As a preferable technical solution of the lithium ion battery, the demagnetizing member is a conductive sheet or a conductive wire.

As a preferable technical scheme of the lithium ion battery, the diameter of the lead is 0.1-10 mm.

In a preferred embodiment of the lithium ion battery, the main body includes a welding portion and a demagnetizing portion, and the welding portion is connected to one end of the demagnetizing portion, which is away from the auxiliary demagnetizing body.

As a preferable technical solution of the lithium ion battery, the welding portion is a conductive sheet, and the demagnetizing portion and the auxiliary demagnetizing body are wires.

The embodiment of the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the curvature of the main body provided with the demagnetizing piece is approximately the same as the winding curvature of the winding type battery cell, when the main body is adjacent to the extending portion, and the current direction of the electrified demagnetizing piece is opposite to that of the extending portion, the main body can generate a magnetic field opposite to that of the extending portion so as to offset the magnetic field generated by most of the extending portion, meanwhile, the auxiliary demagnetizing piece is electrified to generate a magnetic field, and further offset the magnetic field which is not offset by part of the main body, so that the interference of the magnetic field of the extending portion of the negative pole piece on other parts in the electronic equipment is greatly reduced, the quality of the electronic equipment is improved, and the experience of a user is improved.

Drawings

The utility model is explained in more detail below with reference to the figures and examples.

Fig. 1 is a perspective view of a first lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the utility model.

Fig. 2 is a schematic structural diagram of a winding type battery cell, a demagnetizing element, and an insulating adhesive tape in a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention.

Fig. 3 is a perspective view of a second lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the utility model.

Fig. 4 is a perspective view of a third lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the utility model.

FIG. 5 is a perspective view of a demagnetizing element of an embodiment of the present invention disposed on a side of a housing.

FIG. 6 is a top view of a demagnetizing element disposed at an end of a housing according to an embodiment of the present invention.

FIG. 7 is a side view of a demagnetizing element disposed at a side of a housing according to an embodiment of the utility model.

FIG. 8 is a perspective view of the demagnetizing elements of an embodiment of the present invention disposed at the ends and sides of a housing.

In the figure:

1. a housing; 11. a housing body; 12. an upper cover; 2. a winding type battery cell; 21. a positive plate; 22. a negative plate; 221. an extension; 3. a demagnetizing element; 31. a main body; 311. welding the part; 312. a demagnetizing part; 32. an auxiliary demagnetizing body; 4. insulating gummed paper; 41. and (5) opening the gummed paper.

Detailed Description

In order to make the technical problems solved, technical solutions adopted and technical effects achieved by the present invention clearer, the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention will be described in further detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

In the description of the present invention, unless expressly stated or limited otherwise, the terms "connected," "connected," and "fixed" are to be construed broadly, e.g., as meaning permanently connected, removably connected, or integral to one another; can be mechanically or electrically connected; they may be directly connected or indirectly connected through intervening media, or may be connected through the use of two elements or the interaction of two elements. The specific meanings of the above terms in the present invention can be understood in specific cases to those skilled in the art.

In the present invention, unless otherwise expressly stated or limited, "above" or "below" a first feature means that the first and second features are in direct contact, or that the first and second features are not in direct contact but are in contact with each other via another feature therebetween. Also, the first feature being "on," "above" and "over" the second feature includes the first feature being directly on and obliquely above the second feature, or merely indicating that the first feature is at a higher level than the second feature. A first feature being "under," "below," and "beneath" a second feature includes the first feature being directly under and obliquely below the second feature, or simply meaning that the first feature is at a lesser elevation than the second feature.

The lithium ion battery provided by the embodiment of the utility model is applied to electronic equipment (such as a wireless Bluetooth headset), the demagnetization component 3 on the lithium ion battery is connected with the lithium ion battery and a load in the electronic equipment in series, and the demagnetization component 3 generates a magnetic field to counteract the magnetic field generated by the extension part 221 of the negative pole piece 22 of most of the lithium ion battery when the lithium ion battery discharges, so that the interference of the magnetic field generated by the extension part 221 on the electronic equipment is reduced.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, the lithium ion battery includes a casing 1 and a winding type battery cell 2 disposed in the casing 1, the winding type battery cell 2 includes a positive plate 21 and a negative plate 22, the negative plate 22 of the winding type battery cell 2 after winding forming has an extension 221 beyond the end of the positive plate 21 in the length direction, the lithium ion battery further includes a demagnetizing member 3 disposed outside the casing 1, the demagnetizing member 3 includes a main body 31 and an auxiliary demagnetizing body 32, the main body 31 is arc-shaped, the curvature of the main body 31 is substantially the same as the winding curvature of the winding type battery cell 2, one end of the main body 31 is electrically connected to the casing 1, the other end of the main body 31 is connected to the auxiliary demagnetizing body 32, the auxiliary demagnetizing body 32 is disposed at the outer side of the casing 1, the auxiliary demagnetizing body 32 is disposed at a position outside the casing 1 corresponding to a position of the extension portion 221 inside the casing 1, and a curvature of the auxiliary demagnetizing body 32 is substantially the same as a curvature of the extension portion 221 in a width direction. Understandably, when the lithium ion battery is discharged, the current directions of the positive pole piece 21 and the negative pole piece 22 are opposite, most of the generated magnetic fields can be cancelled out, but because the length of the negative pole piece 22 is greater than that of the positive pole piece 21, the magnetic field generated by the extension part 221 of the negative pole piece 22 cannot be cancelled out by the positive pole piece 21, the curvature of the main body 31 is approximately the same as the winding curvature of the winding type battery core 2, when the main body 31 is adjacent to the extension part 221 and the current direction of the electrified demagnetizing piece 3 is opposite to the current direction of the extension part 221, the main body 31 can generate the magnetic field opposite to the magnetic field direction of the extension part 221 so as to cancel most of the magnetic field generated by the extension part 221, and the auxiliary demagnetizing body 32 can generate the magnetic field when being electrified, the magnetic field which cannot be cancelled out by the main body 31 is further cancelled out, so that the interference of the magnetic field of the extension part 221 of the negative pole piece 22 on other parts in the electronic equipment is greatly reduced, therefore, the quality of the electronic equipment is improved, and the experience of a user is improved.

Further, the length of the main body 31 is greater than or equal to the length of the extension 221. Preferably, the length of the main body 31 is greater than that of the extension portion 221, so as to ensure that the magnetic field generated by electrifying the main body 31 can counteract the magnetic field of the extension portion 221 more, thereby improving the demagnetizing effect of the demagnetizing member 3.

Specifically, the case 1 includes a case body 11 and an upper cover 12, the case body 11 is electrically connected to a positive electrode tab 21 to form a positive electrode, and the upper cover 12 is electrically connected to a negative electrode tab 22 to form a negative electrode. In other embodiments, the upper cover 12 is electrically connected to the positive electrode tab 21 to form a positive electrode, and the can body 11 is electrically connected to the negative electrode tab 22 to form a negative electrode.

Further, the main body 31 includes a welding portion 311, the demagnetizing element 3 is welded to the casing 1 through the welding portion 311, so that the demagnetizing element 3 and the casing 1 are electrically conducted, and the lithium ion battery further includes an insulating layer (not shown) for separating the casing 1 and the demagnetizing element 3 except the welding portion 311. The design not only can firmly arrange the demagnetizing piece 3 on the shell 1, but also can ensure that the demagnetizing piece 3 can be only electrically conducted with the shell 1 through the welding part 311, and avoid short circuit caused by the contact and the electricity of the part of the demagnetizing piece 3 except the welding part 311 and the shell 1.

In the present embodiment, referring to fig. 2, an insulating layer is provided between the case 1 and the demagnetizing member 3 except for the welded portion 311. Specifically, the insulating layer is an insulating adhesive tape 4, an adhesive tape opening 41 is formed in the insulating adhesive tape 4, and the welding portion 311 of the main body 31 penetrates through the adhesive tape opening 41 and is fixedly connected to the end face of the housing 1. By providing the adhesive tape opening 41 in the insulating adhesive tape 4, the connection between the welding portion 311 and the end surface of the case 1 can be facilitated, and the structure of the lithium ion battery can be simplified.

Preferably, the shape of the gummed paper opening 41 is a sector, the vertex of the gummed paper opening 41 is the center of the insulating gummed paper 4, the central angle of the gummed paper opening 41 is within the range of the included angle threshold, and the edge of the gummed paper opening 41 is connected with the edge of the insulating gummed paper 4 through a fillet. The fan-shaped gummed paper opening 41 enables the insulating gummed paper 4 to be adapted to welding parts 311 with various sizes and the shell 1 of the lithium ion battery, the application scene of the insulating gummed paper 4 can be expanded, the requirement for the size model of the insulating gummed paper 4 in production is reduced, and therefore the difficulty of manufacturing the insulating gummed paper 4 is reduced.

Preferably, the threshold included angle is in the range of 30-120. Specifically, the central angle of the gummed paper opening 41 is 90 °.

In another embodiment, the insulating layer wraps the demagnetizing members 3 except for the welding portion 311. Specifically, an insulating sleeve (not shown) is sleeved on the housing 1, and the portion of the demagnetizing element 3 except for the welding portion 311 is sleeved in the insulating sleeve.

Specifically, referring to fig. 2, the main body 31 further includes a demagnetizing part 312, the demagnetizing part 312 is arc-shaped, a curvature of the demagnetizing part 312 is substantially the same as a winding curvature of the winding-type electric core 2, one end of the demagnetizing part 312 is connected to the welding part 311, and the other end is connected to the auxiliary demagnetizing body 32.

Further, referring to fig. 1 and 3, the demagnetizing element 3 is a conductive sheet or wire. The conductive sheet body has good welding effect and conductivity, and can be selected from nickel sheets, copper sheets, aluminum sheets and the like; the wire has the flexibility, can form curved main part 31 easily to can reduce the process that forms curved main part 31, the wire has the insulating skin parcel moreover, and lithium ion battery need not to set up the insulating layer, can reduce the process that sets up the insulating layer, improves lithium ion battery's manufacturing efficiency.

Preferably, when a wire is used as the body 31, the wire has a diameter of 0.1 to 10 mm. In order to adapt to the small-volume design of the electronic equipment and avoid occupying too much space, the space can be selected from 1mm, 1.5mm, 2mm, 2.5mm, 3mm and the like.

In another embodiment, referring to fig. 4, the soldering portion 311 is a conductive sheet, and the demagnetizing portion 312 and the auxiliary demagnetizing body 32 are conductive wires. This design combines the advantage of conductive sheet body and wire simultaneously, can utilize the flexibility of wire promptly, is convenient for form curved degaussing portion 312 to the camber that makes degaussing portion 312 is roughly the same with the coiling camber of coiling formula electricity core 2, and the conductive sheet body can make degaussing piece 3 stabilize on casing 1 moreover, guarantees that only weld part 311 is electrically conductive with lithium ion battery.

In the present embodiment, as shown with reference to fig. 1 to 5, the case 1 includes an end portion and a side portion, the end portion includes a top portion and a bottom portion, and the main body 31 is welded to the top portion of the case 1 by a welding portion 311. The demagnetizing part 312 is provided to correspond to the extending part 221, and a magnetic field generated when the lithium battery is discharged can largely cancel a magnetic field generated by most of the extending part 221.

In one embodiment, the main body 31 is welded to the bottom of the housing 1 by a welding portion 311. In another embodiment, the main body 31 is welded to the side of the case 1 by a welding part 311.

Further, referring to fig. 6 and 7, when the main body 31 is disposed at the top or bottom of the casing 1, the arc radius of the main body 31 is a, the radius of the top or bottom of the casing 1 is r, and a is not greater than r;

when the main body 31 is arranged at the side part of the shell 1, the height of the main body 31 is b, and the height of the shell 1 is h, wherein b is less than or equal to h.

In other embodiments, referring to fig. 8, the main body 31 includes a first wall and a second wall arranged at a right angle, the first wall is installed at the top or bottom of the housing 1, and the second wall is installed at the side of the housing 1.

In another embodiment, referring to fig. 9, the lithium ion battery may further be provided with two demagnetizing pieces 3, one ends of the two demagnetizing pieces 3 are respectively connected with the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery, and the other ends are connected with the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the load, so as to form a closed loop.

In the description herein, it is to be understood that the terms "upper", "lower", and the like are used in a descriptive sense or positional relationship based on the orientation or positional relationship shown in the drawings for convenience of description and simplicity of operation, and do not indicate or imply that the referenced device or element must have a particular orientation, be constructed and operated in a particular orientation, and therefore should not be construed as limiting the present invention.

In the description herein, references to the term "an embodiment" or the like are intended to mean that a particular feature, structure, material, or characteristic described in connection with the embodiment is included in at least one embodiment or example of the utility model. In the description, schematic representations of the above terms do not necessarily refer to the same embodiment.

Furthermore, it should be understood that although the present description refers to embodiments, not every embodiment may contain only a single embodiment, and such description is for clarity only, and those skilled in the art should integrate the description, and the embodiments may be appropriately combined to form other embodiments as will be appreciated by those skilled in the art.

The technical principle of the present invention is described above in connection with specific embodiments. The description is made for the purpose of illustrating the principles of the utility model and should not be construed in any way as limiting the scope of the utility model. Based on the explanations herein, those skilled in the art will be able to conceive of other embodiments of the present invention without inventive effort, which would fall within the scope of the present invention.
